decided_by: doc. dr Semir Poturak, editor of record
closes: E-013, open since the news layer was added: the record held headline text with no written rule for how long.
principle: Retain collected headlines, links, publication/reception times and revisions, and show the complete collected archive. Preserve immutable model inputs for reproducibility. Do not collect or publish full article bodies. Public Git retains past published versions; local expiry alone cannot erase those versions.
review: This policy is reviewed whenever a rule is added or a source class changes, and in any case before the record is a year old. Changes are appended to this file's git history and to research/08-provenance/CORRECTIONS.md; the ledger of what was actually erased is data/live/retention-ledger.jsonl and is never rewritten.

rules.name: news headline text
rules.applies_to: rows whose parameter is 'headline', in data/live/rows/<sid>/<month>.jsonl
rules.then: kept indefinitely; headline archive is public, model working context remains local
rules.why: The editor explicitly chose retention and complete headline display on 2026-09-11. Stored digest inputs preserve the evidence used by the model.

rules.name: raw captures of news feeds
rules.applies_to: data/live/raw/<sid>/** for the sids of R1
rules.then: the capture file is deleted; its sha256, byte length and fetch time stay in the receipt, so the chain of custody for every row survives the erasure of the bytes
rules.why: Raw feed payloads may include article summaries beyond the headline archive; retain them for 90 days, preserving capture hashes and receipts afterward.

rules.name: headlines cached in the mind's working context
rules.applies_to: data/live/derived/mind/context.json and the digest cache, fields carrying headline text
rules.then: kept indefinitely; headline archive is public, model working context remains local
rules.why: The editor explicitly chose retention and complete headline display on 2026-09-11. Stored digest inputs preserve the evidence used by the model.

rules.name: measurements
rules.applies_to: every row whose kind is not 'text'
rules.why: A concentration, a river level, a temperature or a count of free parking spaces is not information about an identified person, and the value of an evidence record grows with its length. Deleting them would destroy the only thing this project makes and protect no one.

rules.name: permission captures and access checks
rules.applies_to: data/permissions/** and the registry's access evidence
rules.why: These are the proof that every read was allowed at the moment it happened. They are evidence about publishers and about us, and a record that erases its own justification is worth nothing.

rules.name: objections
rules.applies_to: a request from a person or a publisher, received at the address published on the site
rules.then: acted on within 30 days: the named rows are redacted immediately regardless of age, the source is marked in the registry, and both the request and what was done about it are recorded
rules.why: Objections are reviewed individually. Removing a current page does not erase public Git history or third-party clones; any required history remediation must be tracked explicitly and its limits disclosed.

supersedes: R1 and R3 of the 2026-09-09 policy, by explicit editor instruction to preserve and display all headlines.
